svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from decisions/register.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A =
SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · CONOPS = concept of
operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · EVT-nnn = test
or demonstration event record (safety/events/) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change
and sustainment) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety
(11 May 2012, base edition) · PDaC = Product Development as Code · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA = system hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 205) ·
SUS-M1 = piloted walker · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
